ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT C.CITY, C.COUNTRY, C.PROVINCE, C.YEAR, C.POPULATION AS CITY_POPULATION, P.POPULATION AS PROVINCE_POPULATION FROM MONDIAL_CITYPOPS C JOIN MONDIAL_PROVPOPS P ON C.PROVINCE = P.PROVINCE AND C.COUNTRY = P.COUNTRY WHERE C.COUNTRY = 'D' AND C.YEAR = 2011 AND P.YEAR = 2011 AND C.POPULATION > 0.1 * P.POPULATION ORDER BY C.CITY ASC, C.PROVINCE ASC

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT C.CITY, C.COUNTRY, C.PROVINCE, C.YEAR, C.POPULATION FROM MONDIAL_CITYPOPS C WHERE (C.CITY, C.COUNTRY, C.PROVINCE, C.YEAR) IN (SELECT C1.CITY, C1.COUNTRY, C1.PROVINCE, C1.YEAR FROM MONDIAL_CITYPOPS C1 JOIN MONDIAL_PROVPOPS P1 ON C1.PROVINCE = P1.PROVINCE AND C1.COUNTRY = P1.COUNTRY WHERE C1.COUNTRY = 'D' AND C1.YEAR = 2011 AND P1.YEAR = 2011 AND C1.POPULATION > 0.1 * P1.POPULATION) AND C.POPULATION >= 150000 ORDER BY C.POPULATION DESC, C.CITY ASC, C.PROVINCE ASC
